messages:
emma: Quick question — how should the Console surface role-bindings for route-scoped permissions? Right now the Roles page only shows tenant roles and it's confusing for customers.

mike: We hid per-route bindings on the main Roles list to reduce noise. The current pattern is you click into a route or a service and then see any direct bindings. Might be too hidden :/ 

raj: Hiding is causing support/audit churn. Ops wants a clear "effective permissions" view per route so they can see inbound policies without clicking 10 places. Also affects rollout testing of scoped denies.

sophia: Design thought — add a compact badge on the Roles list: 'x route overrides' that opens a side panel with direct vs inherited toggles. Quick mock here: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXXX/role-visibility (placeholder)

mike: Backend concern: to show effective perms we'd need either a query param to expand inherited mappings or a precomputed view. naive API: GET /roles?scope=tenant&include_inherited=true

raj: That naive approach could explode latency; the RBAC engine is per-tenant canonical. Suggest we precompute an 'effective_bindings' index updated async when binding changes — that would also help telemetry and audit queries.

emma: For rollout we want to canary the UI change to 10% of orgs first. Can we toggle server-side and do an A/B?

sophia: Yup — we can gate using the consoleRollouts feature flag service. We'll need metrics: impressions, open-sidepanel, export-audit.

mike: Also need new telemetry events on the API side: permissions.view and permissions.expand. Example event: ```{"event":"permissions.view","org":"org_123","actor":"user_abc","scope":"route","route":"/v1/generate"}```

raj: Agree on events. From infra POV, precomputed effective_bindings will emit change events to the change-log topic (Kafka) so telemetry can consume.

ops-bot: role-service:role-indexer v2 deployed to staging :rocket: (build 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z)

emma: OK — owners? mike for APIs, raj for indexer, sophia for UI, emma for product rollout. I'll follow up with tickets and a 2-week canary plan. Thanks :thumbsup:
